TextView.android:text: Turn your smartphone into a research-grade Nanoparticle Tracking Analysis (NTA) laboratory using a clip-on microscope lens.
🏆 The Physics: Jean Perrin's 1926 Nobel Prize

Exact lens magnification is not critical because scale is calibrated directly in micrometers per pixel (μm/px):
1. Tap the 'Calibrate' button on the Sim, Camera, or Video tab.
2. Drag a line across a known distance (e.g., a 1 mm mark on a ruler or stage micrometer).
3. Enter the physical distance in micrometers (1000 μm for 1 mm) to establish your exact optical scale.
